# Fixture Shop

> Synthetic llms.txt used by the claude-seo-ai test suite. It follows the llmstxt.org shape:
> one H1 title, a blockquote summary, then H2 sections of markdown links.

The paragraph below the summary is optional prose. It is neither a heading nor a list item, so a
parser has to ignore it rather than treat it as a broken link line.

## Docs

- [Product catalogue](https://fixture.example/catalog): every product with price and availability
- [Shipping policy](/shipping): delivery times per region

## Optional

- [Press kit](https://fixture.example/press): logos and brand assets
